## Key Projects
- **Nepali Tales** (Status: Live | Role: Lead Product Designer)
  - Led 0–1 product design for Nepali Tales, crafting a playful, culturally inspired food-ordering experience from concept to launch.
  - Created brand assets and UI designs, collaborating with developers to bring the experience to launch.
  - Impact: Attracted 5,000+ visitors and 150+ direct orders, reducing manual operational work.
- **Kora - Brand Identity** (Status: Concept / Case Study | Role: Brand & Visual Designer)
  - Developed Kora from concept to brand, shaping its identity around cultural cues, consumer behavior, and a warm, earthy aesthetic.
  - Designed the visual system, including logo, logo motion, brand assets, and packaging across key touchpoints.
- **Redbus Case Study** (Status: Case Study | Role: UX Researcher & Designer)
  - Research-backed mobile ticket checkout redesign addressing interstate bus commuter friction, seat filtering, and route accessibility.
